answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 62782 Country: India Title: Dua for controlling a software Question: Professionally I am a transcriber and using some software for transcribing, but not getting sufficient worth from them, so I would like to know is there any particular dua so that I can recite to get support from Allah in my work. Answer ID: 62782 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 182/183/L=02/1437) Recite the following du’a 111 times daily with concentration on its meaning: حَسْبُنَا اللّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ Allah is fully sufficient for us, and the best One in whom to trust. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
